limitations: The result concerns the genuine full (n+1)-by-9 local coefficient array on the strict proper domain 2n+2*natDegree W<9(n+1), including n=0 and W=0. It does not identify the original five aggregated F outputs with this array.

Every complete Solution retains all 18 original Injectivity proofs and the exact seven Base/Jet proofs selected by actual cross-module value dependency closure. Only actual definition spans, parser-certified print diagnostics and import header are removed, and the selected target references renamed.

Injectivity and the zero-kernel criterion need properness. The actual n=0,W=X^5 nonzero polynomial has every local coefficient zero outside that domain. The n=0,W=X^4 proper polynomial has simple coefficient 1 and actual weightedR=1/t at regular points; strict properness does not imply rho1=0, O(1/t^2) or summability.

All three proofs have only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The statement-reference files intentionally use sorryAx and are never imported by Solutions. The independent project reused only pinned dependency artifacts, never native or staged olean files.

Original aggregate F injectivity/inverse/surjectivity, exact infinite L, denominator/asymptotic obligations, J and zeta(9) irrationality remain open. Other later task files are outside this reviewed proof closure.
